title: Width of a Constructed DNF
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $ts$ be a finite list of terms on $n$ Boolean variables. The width of the DNF with terms $ts$ equals the maximum number of literals in any term of $ts$, with the maximum taken to be $0$ when $ts$ is empty.
hypotheses_covered: $ts$ is a list of terms on $n$ variables
